what: float64 Gauss-Newton step on a uniform tensor grid on [-2, 2)^D for u(x) = sum_h c_h sin(w_h.x + b_h), constant-coefficient L and a separable target: loss, gradient, Gauss-Newton matrix G = sum_x J^T J (P x P, P = (D + 2) H) and the damped step (G + lam I)^-1 g with lam = 1e-8 tr(G) / P and one Cholesky (identical solve for every method); candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.grid_gauss_newton.closed_ridge_grid_gauss_newton (Hadamard products of per-axis moment Gram matrices; no Jacobian). Per-point methods receive the explicit points.
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method on the 3^D (2^D when 3^D > 256) sub-grid of the first nodes vs 40-digit Jacobian rows in the real phase form (independent of the complex Gram derivation): loss 1e-9 / 2e-10, gradient and G 1e-8 / 2e-9 of the largest entry; the step is not qualified (ill-conditioned systems)

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.per_point_closed_form_jacobian: explicit closed-form Jacobian rows + one J^T J GEMM; forward-mode AD Jacobian of the closed-form residual
tiers.taylor_structure_aware_jacobian: forward-mode AD Jacobian of the per-unit Taylor-in-z residual
tiers.taylor_network_level_jacobian: forward-mode AD Jacobian of the network-level jet residual (chunked over points)

roles.held_out: cells and seed not used for any tuning

full_grid_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled magnitude) of loss, gradient, Gauss-Newton Gramian and damped step between methods

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
